abstract: Germ cell tumors of the testis are the most common malignant tumor in young adults. The introduction of the use of cisplatin-based chemotherapy for testicular germ cell tumors from certain tumor stages in the 1970s has significantly improved the prognosis for these tumors. The resection of tumors that have undergone prior chemotherapy, usually in the area of retroperitoneal lymph node metastases or other sites of tumor metastasis, is an important part of the treatment for these patients. But prior treatment with chemotherapy might lead to the development of different special biological forms of germ cell tumors, including the so-called growing teratoma syndrome, somatic-type malignancies, sarcomatoid yolk-sac tumors, vasculogenic mesenchymal lesions, and trophoblastic tumors as well as unspecific changes. Pathologists should be aware of these different histopathologic changes associated with chemotherapy in germ cell tumor patients, as these might even occur years after the initial therapy. This article discusses the classic morphologic subtypes of germ cell tumors and the development of chemotherapy resistance and examines special morphologic forms and the diagnostic handling of postchemotherapy resection specimens.
abstract_ja: 精巣の胚細胞腫瘍は若年成人で最も多い悪性腫瘍です。1970年代に一定の病期の精巣胚細胞腫瘍にシスプラチン併用化学療法が導入されて以来、予後は大幅に改善しました。化学療法を受けた腫瘍の切除、通常は後腹膜リンパ節転移やその他の転移部位での切除は、これらの患者の治療の重要な部分です。しかし、先行する化学療法により、growing teratoma syndrome、体細胞型悪性腫瘍、肉腫様卵黄嚢腫瘍、血管形成性間葉系病変、絨毛性腫瘍、非特異的変化などの特殊な生物学的形態が生じることがあります。病理医は、これらの病理組織学的変化を認識しておく必要があります。初回治療の数年後に生じることもあるためです。本論文では、胚細胞腫瘍の古典的な形態学的亜型と化学療法抵抗性の発生について論じ、特殊な形態と化学療法後切除標本の診断的取扱いを検討します。
